newsitem.title: KUWAIT: Qatar may have to cancel MENA summit - League.
newsitem.headline: Qatar may have to cancel MENA summit - League.

text.p: Qatar might cancel a regional economic summit unless Israel changes its policy, an Arab League assistant secretary-general was quoted on Sunday as saying.

Abdel-Rahman al-Sihibani told al-Rai al-Aam daily more Arab states were now opposed to holding the Middle East and North Africa (MENA) economic summit in Doha in November due to what they see was Israel's blocking of peace talks with Arabs.

"If it convenes it will be just a gathering with Israel's participation, a limited number of Arab states and some representatives of foreign firms and countries," said Sihibani who is in charge of economic affairs.
"Ambassador Sihibani sees that Qatar could have to cancel the MENA conference if there is no change in Israel's policy," the Kuwaiti daily said.

But the tiny Gulf Arab state has said it plans to hold the annual summit, the first to convene in a Gulf state, on time despite calls by some of its allies at least to postpone the event. It was last held in Egypt.
Qatar's powerful neighbour Saudi Arabia and regional ally the United Arab Emirates have already said they would boycott the event in view of the deadlock in Middle East peace talks.
